entries.notes: The original manifest spells 秘. The complete 0705 video, inspected at 0.5-second intervals and in its enlarged completed frame, draws 示 in five strokes (two horizontal strokes, vertical, left dot, right dot), followed by 必 in five strokes. It therefore supplies visual evidence for 祕, not the 禾 form named by the manifest. This is a row-specific observation, not a general equivalence of 秘 and 祕. Candidate geometry still requires a separate completed whole-glyph review.
